items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Bo Stemhammer, who owned the club and operated the club... when we played the first engagement there

ctx.x: any interest to what we're doing on this tape? Is it -- I've never heard of it before. Is it an important jazz spot in Sweden?

It was at the time. When we played the first engagement there -- you know, when we had the three days -- Bo Stemhammer, who owned the club and operated the club, they had just moved in there. And they were still in the process of decorating the club.
